findings.problem: When the two fractions become one, b^{x+2} goes onto the top next to a^{2x+2} and a^{3-y} goes onto the bottom, but the new line just appears, so a student does not see which piece went where.
findings.fix: On "tops together", move b^{x+2} from line 3 into the top of {g1}; on "bottoms together", move a^{3-y} into its bottom, so the grouping is shown as the pieces travel.
